name: Junior Squam Lakes Association (JSLA) Summer Camp
description_short: A nature and environmental education day camp run by the Squam Lakes Association in Holderness, NH, for kids entering grades 3–12. Campers paddle, hike and swim in groups by grade, and some weeks include overnights. Camp runs Mon–Fri, 8:30 AM–3:30 PM, with Friday pickup at 2:30 PM.
refund_policy_summary: All cancellations have a $25 admin fee. Cancel more than 30 days before the session for a full refund minus $25, or 14–30 days before for a 50% refund minus $25. No refund if you cancel less than 14 days before, withdraw on the day or don't attend, unless there is a documented medical emergency. You can move to another session at no extra cost if space allows. If SLA cancels a session, you get a 100% refund.
